children: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions announced a hardware price increase for RAD products to reflect rising materials, compute and transportation costs.
Effective Sept 22, 2026 channel pricing for ROSA and AVA increased by ~6% to address higher input costs.
Higher percentage increases apply to the RIO product family due to steel‑intensive, self‑contained platforms.
ROAMEO pricing remains unchanged, maintaining existing positioning for that product line.
Previously quoted opportunities remain valid at prior pricing through Oct 31, 2026; new quotes reflect revised pricing.
Company expects expanding product lineup (including SARA deployments and a new hardware launch) may offset near‑term sales impacts.
